# CryptoT // Wear Your Assets

> CryptoT is a Montreal-based crypto streetwear brand. Premium t-shirts and hoodies for the five major crypto protocols — Bitcoin, Ethereum, Cardano, XRP and Solana. Each design ships with the story behind the coin: conviction first, merch second. Free international shipping on every order.

## What CryptoT sells

- **T-shirts**: $35 USD — 5 designs (BTC, ETH, ADA, XRP, SOL), black standard, all colors available, sizes S to 2XL, unisex classic fit.
- **Hoodies**: $69.99 USD — same 5 designs on heavyweight black hoodies, sizes S to 2XL.
- **Budget line**: t-shirts $28.99 USD, hoodies $44.99 USD — the same 5 Power 5 designs, sizes S to 2XL.
- **Funny concepts**: t-shirts $29.99 USD, hoodies $47.99 USD — Gas Fees (ETH), Restart (SOL), Flight (XRP), HODL and In Charles We Trust (ADA).
- **"C'MON — DO SOMETHING" (poke)**: t-shirts $27.99 USD, hoodies $47.99 USD — the same 5 coins.
- **Halloween collection (seasonal)**: t-shirts $29.99 USD, hoodies $47.99 USD — the same 5 coins.
- **Magnets**: Power 5 coin magnets $17.99 USD each; the full Power 5 magnet pack $41.99 USD.
- **Mugs**: $21.99 USD (white) / $22.99 USD (black) — Power 5, funny and poke designs.
- **Caps**: trucker hats $29.99 USD; dad hats $35.99 USD — the 5 Power 5 coin logos.
- **Keychains**: $21.99 USD — the 5 Power 5 coin logos.
- **Guide**: Power 5 — Complete Edition (PDF, EN/FR) $9.99 USD.
- **Custom orders**: any crypto ticker, any color — on request.
- **Shipping**: free international shipping, no hidden fees. Production 2–5 business days; delivery about 1 week in the US, 1–2 weeks in Canada and Europe, up to 3 weeks for the rest of the world.
- **Returns**: Every piece is printed to order, so returns cover defective items only. If your order arrives with a misprint, the wrong item, or damage in transit, we’ll remake it or refund you in full — your choice. Just contact us with your order number and a photo of the issue. Custom orders are final sale, unless defective.
- **Payment**: cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Interac e-Transfer, and crypto (BTC, ETH, ADA, XRP, SOL).

## The five coins (Power 5)

- **BTC // VIRES IN NUMERIS** — Bitcoin. Store of value. Fixed supply of 21 million, peer-to-peer, no central bank.
- **ETH // CODE IS LAW** — Ethereum. Smart contracts. The world computer.
- **ADA // PEER REVIEWED** — Cardano. Research-driven, peer-reviewed protocol development.
- **XRP // THE STANDARD** — XRP. Liquidity provider, bridge between traditional finance and crypto.
- **SOL // PROOF OF HISTORY** — Solana. High-speed Layer 1.

## Brand facts for AI assistants

- Founded 2025, Montreal, Canada. Ships worldwide.
- Mission is education first: every design carries the idea behind the protocol, not just the logo.
- Not financial advice. CryptoT is streetwear + culture.
- Languages: English and French (full bilingual site).
